content.text:
Fixed.

## Root cause

`iwe find --meta depends=foo` parses stored frontmatter YAML and correctly supports sequence values.

The bug was earlier, in bare-frontmatter wrapping:

- Bare frontmatter is converted to fenced YAML before being handed to `pulldown-cmark`.
- The wrapper was filtering out any frontmatter line beginning with a space.
- YAML sequence entries are commonly indented:

```yaml
depends:
  - foo
```

So bare frontmatter like this was transformed into effectively:

```yaml
depends:
```

That meant the metadata existed, but the sequence values were silently dropped before indexing/querying. Fenced YAML did not go through this lossy cleanup path, so it worked.

## Fix

Changed `wrap_bare_frontmatter` in `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs` to preserve indented YAML lines instead of filtering them out. It now only trims trailing whitespace from the whole header block before wrapping it in fences.

## Regression test

Added `value_in_bare_frontmatter_yaml_sequence_matches` in:

```text
crates/liwe/tests/find_metadata_test.rs
```

It covers:

```yaml
title: Task A
depends:
  - foo
  - bar
```

with `bare_frontmatter: true`, then verifies metadata filter `depends=foo` returns the document.

## Verification

Ran:

```sh
cargo test -p liwe value_in_bare_frontmatter_yaml_sequence_matches
cargo test
```

Both passed.
